## Appendix B1. The 29 TabArena binary tasks: rows, criteria and attribute lists (generated by `analysis/addendum_b_appendix.py` from the package's metadata)

Excluded dataset: diabetes, the Pima data, already analyzed as PIMA in the thirty (identical rows; package finding 4).

**B1.1. blood-transfusion-service-center** (OpenML 46913, task 363621). n = 748; criterion: DonatedBloodInMarch2007; C1 = No (570), C0 = Yes (178). Rows: all. Cross-validation: 10 x stratified 10-fold. Attributes (4): MonthsSinceLastDonation, NumberOfDonations, TotalBloodDonated, MonthsSinceFirstDonation. Excluded: none beyond the target. Curation: CODING: features renamed only (curators note 29% duplicate rows).

**B1.2. credit-g** (OpenML 46918, task 363626). n = 1,000; criterion: good_or_bad_customer; C1 = good (700), C0 = bad (300). Rows: all. Cross-validation: 10 x stratified 10-fold. Attributes (20): checking_status, duration_months, credit_history, credit_purpose, credit_amount, savings_status, employment_since, installment_rate_percent, personal_status_sex, other_debtors, residence_since, property, age_years, other_installment_plans, housing, existing_credits_count, job, people_liable, telephone, foreign_worker. Excluded: none beyond the target. 3 column(s) carry literal strings such as 'nan' or 'unknown', read as ordinary values. Curation: CODING: the original ordinal encoding reversed into labels (Statlog German Credit).
